description: Raw responses from the DLD Rental Index calculator (Residential tab, Search Index by Area), captured from the calculator page's own network response (POST /umbraco/surface/CaptchaProxy/CalculateRentalIndex) during normal use of the public form. Used as evidence for Decree 43 band behaviour at exact band edges and between bands. PDF export did not work in the browser used, so the raw responses are kept instead.

response.Result: When renewing real property lease contracts, the maximum percentage of rent increase for real property in the Emirate of Dubai, no rent increase where the rent of the real property unit is up to 10% less than the average rental value of similar units.
response.Result1: The rent for a 3 bed rooms+hall Hotel Apartment in Al Hamriya is in range 81000 to 99000 AED per year, (does not include water, electricity or any other fees).
response.Note: There is no increase in the rental value.
response.AdditionalInfo: The index values do not include water, electricity, or any other additional fees.

Addendum.Text: A copy of Decree No. 43/2013, which regulates rental increases.
A copy of the mathematical equation used in the rental index service.
